protocol: wake 07:00 reporting last night (7.5 h; 5 h in debt), 24 h awake (16 h in workday); 50-min task blocks and 10-min breaks; one webcam window per minute from 07:30 (breaks included); PVT every 2 h and 4 min after each check-in; check-ins evenly from 08:30 to 22:30 (workday 21:30), k = 1 at 10:00; MAE every 10 min from 07:30; night = 23:00 to 07:00
common_random_numbers: person seed independent of k; truth, webcam and 2-hourly PVTs identical across k
twin: released defaults (DEFAULT_CONFIG, forward models fitted on DROZY); no parameter tuned on simulated people

scenarios.misreport: Body clock off by up to 2 h and sleep misreported (SD 1.5 h)
scenarios.ratingbias: People rate themselves with a personal bias (SD 0.8) and more noise (SD 1.0)
scenarios.autocorr: Webcam noise far more autocorrelated than assumed (rho 0.7)
scenarios.trait: Person-specific Three-Process Model: homeostatic decay x exp(N(0, 0.3)), circadian amplitude x exp(N(0, 0.2))
scenarios.debt: Unrecorded sleep debt: 5 h on each of the last 5 nights; the twin is told only about last night
scenarios.dissociation: Ratings level off: above KSS 5 only half of any further rise is reported; passive signals follow the true state
